notes.title: Performance & Compatibility Update for Hidden Nemesis
notes.notes:
In this update, we've addressed key performance and compatibility issues to enhance your gameplay experience. A critical bug affecting NVIDIA 40-series graphics cards has been fixed, ensuring smoother performance for affected players. We've also introduced a new Auto-Adjust Settings button for fall, though some graphical settings may still require fine-tuning. Additionally, we've resolved an issue where Unreal Engine's anti-aliasing settings were causing unexpectedly low FPS.

Your feedback is invaluable—let us know how these changes improve your experience!

notes.title: Announcement: Hidden Nemesis Update
notes.notes:
Dear players and supporters,

We want to take a moment to thank you for your interest in our project, Hidden Nemesis. This game, previously known as Six Days, has been a significant step in our journey as an indie studio, and we’ve learned so much from the development process. Today, we’d like to share some important updates about its status and our plans moving forward.

[h2]The Journey of Hidden Nemesis[/h2]

From the very beginning, Hidden Nemesis was a project close to our hearts. Inspired by classics like Five Nights at Freddy’s, we set out to create a horror experience that would challenge players with suspense and strategy. However, as development progressed, we encountered critical issues with the game’s architecture, which made implementing changes and improvements extremely difficult.

Despite our best efforts, we realized that the game would not meet the standards we strive for as developers. Testing feedback also highlighted areas that required more polish than we could provide within a reasonable timeframe. While this was a tough decision, we believe it’s essential to be transparent about our challenges and focus on delivering quality experiences.

[h2]A New Plan: Making Hidden Nemesis Free[/h2]

Rather than shelving the project entirely, we’ve decided to make Hidden Nemesis available to everyone for free starting February 2024. This decision reflects our gratitude to you, our community, and our desire to share what we’ve built, even if it’s not perfect. We hope that playing the game will give you a glimpse into our creative process and provide some enjoyment.

[h2]What Comes Next?[/h2]

Moving forward, we’re committed to applying the lessons we’ve learned to our future projects. Good system design, better planning, and maintaining flexibility during development are top priorities for us. While Hidden Nemesis may not have turned out as we originally envisioned, it has helped us grow immensely as developers.

[b]Thank you for your continued support and encouragement. If you’d like to try Hidden Nemesis when it becomes available, stay tuned for more updates on our social media channels and website. We can’t wait to share what we’re working on next![/b]

With gratitude,

The Tzavis Studio Team

notes.title: Upcoming Title Change Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We wanted to inform you about an important update regarding our game previously titled *Six Days*. After discussions with Highwire Games, the creators of *[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1548850/Six_Days_in_Fallujah/]Six Days in Fallujah[/url]*, we have agreed to change our game’s name to ensure clarity and respect for their established brand. Victura, Inc., the publisher of Six Days in Fallujah holds the trademark for “Six Days” in connection with video game products, and we appreciate their professional approach in reaching out to us directly to resolve this matter.

We’re currently working on selecting a new title, and we’ll share this exciting update with you as soon as it’s finalized. Thank you all for your understanding and continued support—we’re grateful for our community and are excited to continue this journey with you under our upcoming new name!

Thank you,  
The Tzavis Studio Team

notes.title: Announcing the Six Days Alpha Playtest – Phase 1 Now Live!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43346622/51f10a85d706506a1ff24c4b3389a98387a2f1dc.png[/img]

We are excited to announce that the Alpha Playtest for Six Days is officially live! 🎉 This marks a major milestone for the development of our horror survival puzzle game, and we’re thrilled to share this experience with you.

[b]What’s in the Alpha Playtest?[/b]
In this first phase of the playtest, you’ll be able to experience the first three days of Six Days. During this time, players will face terrifying encounters, solve intricate puzzles, and manage resources to survive the relentless hunt of a demon. This version tests the core gameplay mechanics and functionality, including:

[list]
[*] Puzzle-solving and survival elements
[*] Resource management to keep the demon at bay
[*] Camera and computer navigation to explore the game's labyrinth of mysteries
[/list]

We are eager to hear your feedback, as it will play a crucial role in shaping the final version of the game.

[b]Thank You to Our Testers![/b]
We want to extend a huge thank you to the over 300 players who have already joined the playtest! Your participation is invaluable to us, and we can’t wait to hear what you think. If you haven't joined yet, there are still spots available as we continue into Phase 2 of the testing process!

[b]How to Get Involved[/b]
To participate in the playtest, simply:

Join our Discord to engage with the community and share feedback.
Complete our feedback surveys to let us know about your experience and any bugs or issues you encounter.
Contact us directly via email if you prefer to provide detailed feedback in private.
[b]Your input will directly influence the future of Six Days, so we encourage you to share your thoughts and help us create the best possible version of the game.[/b]

[b]Wishlist Six Days on Steam![/b]
While you're here, don’t forget to add Six Days to your wishlist on Steam! Stay up to date with all our latest announcements, updates, and the eventual full release of the game.

[i][b]Thank you again for being a part of this exciting journey with us. We couldn’t do it without your support, and we’re looking forward to hearing your thoughts on the Six Days Alpha Playtest.[/b][/i]
